name: PS5CEMU HAR
description: Native PS5 homebrew emulator suite combining Cemu for Wii U and Azahar for Nintendo 3DS. Features Vulkan rendering through RADV, DualSense controls and motion, Wii U GamePad touchpad support, 3DS touch-screen emulation, graphic packs, save states, cheats, amiibo support, multiplayer, game libraries, 120 Hz output and per-game settings. Requires your own legally obtained game dumps, keys and system files where required.
author: premohq
